description:
Learnathon is a celebration of learning, of our free content here at SciShow and all of Complexly! We’re doing activities and videos and livestream Nov 9-20 at http://complexly.org/LEARNATHON 

A popular way to eat oysters is raw on the half shell, often alongside a crisp glass of bubbly at a totally Instagrammable happy hour spot. But is there any safe way to eat raw oysters? Here are the risks, and how you can avoid a bad bellyache.

Hosted by: Dr. Imogene Cancellare (she/her)
